items.title: Anthropic's Claude AI submitted false murder tip to Philadelphia police
items.excerpt: 'I may have information regarding this case,' Anthropic's Claude AI agent told Philadelphia police — a tip about an unsolved homicide that turned out to be false.

items.title: Silicon Valley is falling in line with Trump’s attempt to rename AI
items.excerpt: Musk, Benioff, Huang, and now Nadella have all adopted the White House's 'super intelligence' rebrand ordered for federal agencies. (Follow-up to an already-published executive order.)

items.title: The Yandex outage probably didn’t blitz Russian bots
items.excerpt: The Verge pushes back on claims that Ukrainian drone strikes on Yandex AI data centers knocked Russian bot networks offline: 'Not the bots you're probably picturing, that is.' (Follow-up to the 10-10 Yandex strike story.)

items.title: Anthropic is cutting off its internal evaluations from the internet
items.excerpt: Anthropic says it will keep its agents offline during testing until it can prevent 'unintended model actions', amid the federal response to rogue-agent incidents.

items.title: Ukrainian drone strikes on Yandex datacenters knock cloud and payments offline
items.excerpt: Techies at 'Russia's Google' work around the clock as users await access to funds and network connectivity falls to 30% of normal after strikes on Yandex AI datacenters. (Follow-up to the 10-10 strike story.)

items.title: Chatbot refuseniks edge out users in the US, and they’re not for turning
items.excerpt: A Pew Research Center survey finds 51% of Americans say they do not use AI chatbots, citing lack of interest rather than know-how as the top reason.

items.title: Von der Leyen pitches AI as solution to reduce reporting for European businesses
items.excerpt: For the first time, the European Commission President explicitly proposed using AI tools to cut administrative reporting burdens for EU businesses.

items.title: These Midterm Races Will Decide Data Centers’ Political Fate
items.excerpt: From Senate races to governors' mansions, candidates are competing to be the most anti-data center, putting AI datacenter siting on the ballot across the US.

items.title: AI Governance Is Being Decided Now, and the Public Isn’t in the Room
items.excerpt: Mackenzie Austin argues AI companies have an opportunity to make good on stated commitments to democratic AI governance as rules are being set now. (Commentary.)

items.title: Shaping global governance of AI agents
items.excerpt: Landry Signé and Karla Yee Amezaga outline how AI agents strain existing governance models and what practical international oversight should look like.

items.title: As AI leaders call for slowdown, children need a voice
items.excerpt: As AI industry leaders call for a slowdown, Brookings argues children's interests must be represented in AI policy debates.

items.title: 10 Takeaways from Q3
items.excerpt: ChinaTalk's quarterly roundup on AI, China, defense, national security and supply chains. (Analysis roundup.)

items.title: House proposal would clarify liability rules for AI agents
items.excerpt: Developers would be held liable under a House draft bill when their AI agents harm third parties through conduct that would be unlawful if committed by a human. (Off-list: no on-list outlet carried it.)

items.title: Barrett Introduces Bill to Create Federal AI Oversight Office
items.excerpt: Rep. Tom Barrett (R-Mich.) introduced the Artificial Intelligence Governance and Emerging Threats Act on Oct. 9, which would create a Cabinet-level White House office to coordinate federal AI policy and monitor emerging technology threats. (Off-list.)

items.title: White House AI Task Force Weighs Safety, US Competitiveness
items.excerpt: OPM Director Scott Kupor, vice chair of the White House 'Super Intelligence Force', said AI companies must take responsibility for product safety and data center resource demands as the task force develops oversight recommendations. (Off-list.)

items.title: Defense ministry opens military's 1st AI transformation base
items.excerpt: South Korea's defense ministry opened the military's first AI transformation (AX) hub in Pangyo for joint civilian-military AI research. (Off-list.)
